# sprint topic automation

Package: `@hyungjuk/sprint` · Version: `1.1.0`

[CLI index](../../README.md) · [Parent](../topic.md)

## Help

```text
NAME
  sprint topic automation — Discover commands and connect AI agents through CLI or MCP.

SYNOPSIS
  sprint topic automation [FLAGS]

DESCRIPTION
  Discover commands and connect AI agents through CLI or MCP.

EXAMPLES
  sprint issues get --help
  sprint --schema issues
  sprint mcp serve --profile default --domains issues

POSITIONAL ARGUMENTS
  None; see SYNOPSIS for required input flags.

FLAGS
  No command-specific flags.

GLOBAL FLAGS
  --help, -h                 Show command help without authentication or network.
  --schema [DOMAIN]          Print API action contracts as JSON; not CLI flag syntax.
  --llms [DOMAIN]            AI guide; DOMAIN selects action-contract JSON.
  --profile NAME             Select a private Sprint profile (default: default).
  --token-file FILE          Use an owned mode 0600 automation-token JSON file.
  --non-interactive          Never prompt; startup auto-update is skipped.
  --wait                     Observe an accepted job without retrying the mutation.
  --timeout SECONDS          Wait timeout, 1..3600; requires --wait (default: 30).

OUTPUT
  output text on stdout; errors on stderr.

AUTHENTICATION
  No existing Sprint session required. Business login/public commands still require an explicit server origin.

NOTES
  Installation: npm install --global @hyungjuk/sprint
  CLI installation alone does not tell an AI agent when to use it. Add project instructions and optionally register the existing MCP server.
  Start with group help, then exact command help. Use --schema DOMAIN for API contracts, not as a replacement for CLI syntax.
  Use --non-interactive and parse business JSON output. Help and schemas are offline; business operations require a configured server and Sprint authentication.
  Never create or complete an issue solely because a user asked a question. Confirm the target project and requested scope.

SEE ALSO
  sprint help topic
  sprint topic output
  Documentation: https://github.com/Hyungjuk42/sprint-docs/blob/main/cli/reference/topic/automation.md
```
